name: Vercel Sandbox
summary: Vercel Sandbox runs untrusted or agent-generated code in Firecracker microVMs, each with its own filesystem and network, driven by a JS SDK, Python SDK or CLI. Sandboxes persist state on stop by default, and a network firewall can broker credentials by injecting secrets into outbound requests so they never sit inside the sandbox. CPU is billed only while actively used.
facts: Auto-saves state on stop by default; snapshots and drives
Hobby: 5 Active CPU hours and 5,000 creations per month
Up to 32 vCPU / 64 GB RAM (Enterprise), 64 GB disk
Firewall brokers secrets into outbound requests
goodFor: Agents that wait on model calls (CPU billed only when active)
Keeping API keys out of the sandbox via credential brokering
watchOut: Memory is billed for the whole run, including idle time
